newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates generally steady.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates generally steady.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were generally steady, except for the one-month maturities which edged up 11 1/8 percent from 11 1/16, traders said on Friday.

Traders said banks remained calm despite reports that President Fidel Ramos underwent surgery to remove a block in an artery earlier in the day. "The assurance made by government officials that the president was in stable condition after the operation calmed frayed nerves," said one trader.
The increase in the one-month PHIBOR was just a slight distortion, traders said.
